import sys, os, json, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/opt/tools')
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
from rcb_client import Robot, EpisodeOver

OUT='/app/output'
r=Robot()
json.dump(r.spec(),open(OUT+'/spec.json','w'),indent=2)
print('SPEC',json.dumps(r.spec()),flush=True)
step=0
obs=None

def record(res,label):
    global obs,step
    obs=res
    d=f'{OUT}/{step:03d}_{label}'
    res.save(d)
    cams=list(res.last)
    board=Image.new('RGB',(640,260*((len(cams)+1)//2)),(30,30,30))
    draw=ImageDraw.Draw(board)
    for i,c in enumerate(cams):
        board.paste(Image.fromarray(res.last[c]),((i%2)*320,(i//2)*260+20))
        draw.text(((i%2)*320,(i//2)*260),c,fill='white')
    board.save(OUT+'/latest.jpg')
    print('RESULT',d,json.dumps(res.meta),flush=True)
    step+=1
    return res

record(r.get_obs(cameras=('head_camera','front_camera','left_camera','right_camera','observer_camera','world_camera1'),include_depth=True),'initial')
for line in sys.stdin:
    try:
        cmd=json.loads(line)
        if cmd['op']=='obs':
            record(r.get_obs(cameras=tuple(cmd.get('cameras',['head_camera','front_camera','left_camera','right_camera','observer_camera','world_camera1'])),include_depth=cmd.get('depth',True),seconds=cmd.get('seconds',0),video='both'),'observe')
        elif cmd['op']=='ee':
            record(r.submit('ee_pose',cmd['actions'],include_depth=True,cameras=('head_camera','front_camera','left_camera','right_camera','observer_camera','world_camera1'),video='both',note=cmd.get('note','')),'ee')
        elif cmd['op']=='joint':
            record(r.submit('joint_position',cmd['actions'],dt=cmd.get('dt',.05),include_depth=True,cameras=('head_camera','front_camera','left_camera','right_camera','observer_camera','world_camera1'),video='both',note=cmd.get('note','')),'joint')
        elif cmd['op']=='exit': break
    except EpisodeOver as e:
        print('EPISODE_OVER',str(e),flush=True)
        break
    except Exception as e:
        print('ERROR',repr(e),flush=True)
